description: Search properties by location, price, beds/baths, type, and status with sorting and pagination.

city.description: Optional city to filter by (exact, case-insensitive).

state.description: Optional state to filter by (exact, case-insensitive).

home_type.description: Optional home type to filter by (e.g. SingleFamily).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

sort_by.description: Sort field: list_price (default), zestimate, days_on_zillow, or living_area_sqft.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has total, count, offset, limit, and a 'results' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single property by its zpid.

zpid.description: The unique zpid of the property.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the property object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the zestimate summary for a property by its zpid.

zpid.description: The unique zpid of the property.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has zestimate details and delta_pct; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the price history events for a property by its zpid.

zpid.description: The unique zpid of the property.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has zpid, count, and a 'history' list; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List agents, optionally filtered by the city/state of the properties they list.

city.description: Optional city to filter agents by (via their listings).

state.description: Optional state to filter agents by (via their listings).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has count and an 'agents' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single agent by id along with their active listings.

agent_id.description: The unique id of the agent.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the agent object with a 'listings' list; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List saved searches for a user.

user_id.description: The id of the user whose saved searches are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has count and a 'results' list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a saved search for a user with the given criteria.

user_id.description: The id of the user the saved search belongs to.

name.description: A display name for the saved search.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created saved search; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Delete a saved search by its id.

search_id.description: The id of the saved search to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.
